loc.fort.entrance.name: Yokotank's Fortress, entrance
loc.fort.entrance.desc: Come on. Stop checking your location and just keep going already. (lol)
loc.flame_mountain.mountain.name: Flame Mountain
loc.flame_mountain.mountain.desc: A mountain near Flame Town. You can't go any further without crossing it.
loc.unknown_land.road.name: The Unknown Land
loc.unknown_land.road.desc: The other side of Flame Mountain. An unknown world.
loc.flame_town.outside.name: Outside Flame Town
loc.flame_town.outside.desc: Just past Flame Town. Flame Mountain lies ahead.
loc.flame_town.town.name: Flame Town
loc.flame_town.town.desc: Flame Town, the scorching town. Along with the warm weather, the people here supposedly have hot, fiery souls. But right now, it's in ruins.
loc.warehouse.road.name: Road
loc.warehouse.road.desc: Where you warped to from Yamijin's secret warehouse. Actually, it's the area on top of the building. Why it's paved with concrete? Let's just not worry about that. (lmao)
loc.arkhaia.outside.name: Outside Arkhaia City
loc.arkhaia.outside.desc: Just outside Arkhaia City. There seems to be a town up ahead...
loc.home.hallway.name: Hallway of {player}'s house
loc.home.hallway.desc: A long hallway running sideways. It leads to all sorts of rooms. It's surprisingly easy to get lost, so watch where you're going.
loc.crystal.outside.name: Outside town
loc.crystal.outside.desc: Just outside town. For some reason, Powerful Gakishonen are wandering around looking for food.
loc.crystal.city.name: Crystal City
loc.crystal.city.desc: The town where {player} lives. It's not super developed, but it's more city than country.
